dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking and discrete 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli are visible along the dorsal-lateral flank. Prominent structures exhibit high-contrast perimeters with a sharp transition from dark exterior boundaries to lighter, lower-intensity interior cores. Geometry is predominantly elliptical with irregular, crenulated edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters localized primarily in the central dorsal region. These clusters are asymmetrical, lack an internal gradient, and are interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Spatial relationships are defined by a series of irregular polygons and triangles formed by connecting the centroids of the five most prominent macro-annuli along the upper flank, following the curvature of the dorsal ridge.
